India Adjusts Export Duties on Fuel Products

The Indian government has eliminated the export duty on petrol while increasing the windfall tax on exports of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF). This adjustment aims to rebalance domestic supply and international market demands for these refined petroleum products.
